news.body: Patriots RB Rhamondre Stevenson (knee) is officially active for a Week 5 matchup with the Raiders.
news.head: Rhamondre Stevenson (knee) officially active for Week 5
news.impact: Stevenson was rolled up on late in the Patriots' win last week, but appears to be good to go against Las Vegas in Week 5. Fantasy managers should expect the Patriots to continue to operate a split backfield with Stevenson and TreVeyon Henderson.

news.body: Rico Dowdle ran 9 times for 41 yards and caught all six of his targets for 45 yards in the Steelers' 16-10 win over the Saints.
news.head: Rico Dowdle snags six passes in win
news.impact: Dowdle really saw his numbers come up in this game after a disappointing outing against Tampa Bay. Not that his efficiency running the ball was bad then, but he simply didn't receive many opportunities. Dowdle is looking like an RB3 type of play moving forward.

news.body: Rico Dowdle (knee) is officially active for Week 7 for the Pittsburgh Steelers against the New Orleans Saints according to Nick Farabaugh.
news.head: Rico Dowdle (knee) active for Week 7
news.impact: Dowdle will suit up after struggling through limited practice sessions late in the week, offering head coach Mike McCarthy another option out of the Pittsburgh backfield behind Jaylen Warren against the Saints.

news.body: Rico Dowdle (knee) was limited at practice again on Thursday.
news.head: Rico Dowdle (knee) limited again Thursday
news.impact: The veteran running back was limited for another practice session on Thursday as he continues to manage a knee injury of some kind. He was able to play through it last week, however, so the expectation is that he will do the same again in Week 7.

news.body: Rico Dowdle (knee) was a limited participant at practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Rico Dowdle (knee) limited participant Wednesday
news.impact: The veteran was limited on Wednesday as he continues to manage the nagging effects of a knee issue. He should be good to go for Week 7, however, and projects to continue to play second fiddle on Pittsburgh's offense behind Jaylen Warren moving forward.

news.body: RJ Harvey rushed three times for six yards, while catching both of his targets for 54 yards and one touchdown in the Broncos' 30-16 win over the Cardinals in Week 7
news.head: RJ Harvey Scores 52-Yard Touchdown in Week 7
news.impact: Harvey turned a short pass from Bo Nix into a 52-yard touchdown for his biggest play of the afternoon. The touchdown saved an otherwise quiet day, as Harvey received just five touches with Jonah Coleman returning to the lineup. Harvey remains involved as a receiver, but Coleman's return adds another player to an already crowded Denver backfield. The former is in flex territory.

news.body: RJ Harvey ran six times for 25 yards and a touchdown while also catching three of four targets for 31 yards in the Broncos' 17-14 win over Seattle on Thursday.
news.head: RJ Harvey bounces back in Thursday win
news.impact: After going silent in Week 5, Harvey got back on track in Week 6, scoring a touchdown and even leading the Broncos in receiving. That last bit is a huge indictment of the Broncos' passing game, which has struggled mightily this year. Harvey is an RB3 at best right now, but if you have other options with a more stable floor who can start, that's likely the best course of action.

news.body: RJ Harvey gained seven yards on three carries and failed to catch his only target in Sunday's 23-17 win over the Chargers.
news.head: RJ Harvey a non-factor in Week 5 win
news.impact: A week after coming up with 10 catches, Harvey was blanked in the passing game and limited to just three touches Sunday afternoon. J.K. Dobbins shouldered the load out of the backfield in this victory, making it clear that Harvey is still firmly behind him on the depth chart. Harvey is a worthwhile handcuff to stash, but he is game-script dependent and unreliable as long as Dobbins remains healthy.

news.body: J.K. Dobbins rushed 11 times for 40 yards, while RJ Harvey had seven carries for 25 yards in Sunday's 24-14 loss to the San Francisco 49ers. Harvey also caught 10 passes for 68 yards out of the backfield.
news.head: RJ Harvey, J.K. Dobbins struggle in loss Sunday
news.impact: Denver couldn't get much going on the ground, with Dobbins and Harvey combining for just 65 rushing yards. Dobbins continued to handle more of the rushing work, but Harvey was much more involved as a receiver and ended up leading the Broncos in both receptions and receiving yards. The backfield remains a split, with Dobbins having the better chance at early-down work and Harvey carrying more upside in the passing game.

news.body: Samaje Perine rushed for 16 yards and a touchdown on four carries in a 35-13 2in over the Ravens.
news.head: Samaje Perine finds the end zone in Week 7 win
news.impact: Perine plunged into the end zone on a one-yard rush early in the fourth quarter to extend the Bengals' lead. The veteran continues to see limited work and can remain off fantasy managers' radar for now.

news.body: Samaje Perine rushed the ball 14 times for 68 yards and caught two passes for ten yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 31-24 win over the Miami Dolphins.
news.head: Samaje Perine leads team in rushing Sunday
news.impact: Perine had a good game on Sunday. He was Cincinnati's leading rusher against the Dolphins and actually saw more overall carries than Chase Brown, who usually acts as the team's RB1. The veteran could be relevant moving forward if he can continue to accumulate significant touches on this offense moving forward.

news.body: Samaje Perine rushed the ball three times for seven yards in Sunday's 22-17 loss to the Jacksonville Jaguars.
news.head: Samaje Perine uninvolved in loss Sunday
news.impact: The veteran didn't do much on Sunday, finishing with just seven yards in the team's loss to the Jaguars. He is clearly the team's backup at this point and doesn't project to be an effective fantasy asset for the foreseeable future.

news.body: Samaje Perine tallied nine rushing yards on three carries in a 30-27 loss to the Steelers. He caught 1-of-3 targets for five yards.
news.head: Samaje Perine sees four touches in Week 3
news.impact: Perine continues to serve as the primary backup behind Chase Brown, but has not logged enough volume to be on the fantasy radar. Fantasy managers can leave him on the wire ahead of a matchup with Jacksonville in Week 4.

news.body: Saquon Barkley was not seen at practice on Thursday.
news.head: Saquon Barkley (hamstring/back) not seen at practice Thursday
news.impact: Barkley did not participate in Wednesday's walkthrough. He will need to be monitored in practice on Friday off a short week.

news.body: Saquon Barkley did not participate in Wednesday’s walkthrough practice.
news.head: Saquon Barkley (hamstring/back) misses walkthrough practice Wednesday
news.impact: Barkley returned in Week 7 against the Cowboys, but appeared to get banged up again. He'll need to be monitored in practice the rest of the week.

news.body: Saquon Barkley rushed the ball seven times for 62 yards and a touchdown in Monday night's 38-21 loss to the Dallas Cowboys.
news.head: Saquon Barkley gets banged up in return game Monday
news.impact: Monday night was Barkley's return game after he misses several weeks with a hamstring issue. He looked good with 62 yards and a touchdown in his limited action, but he tweaked his hamstring and suffered a new back issue that may affect him moving forward. Fantasy managers should keep close tabs on his injury status heading into Week 8.

news.body: Saquon Barkley (hamstring) is taking part in Philadelphia's practice again on Friday.
news.head: Saquon Barkley (hamstring) practicing again Friday
news.impact: Barkley is practicing in a second-straight practice on Friday. It's unclear whether or not he is limited in any capacity, but either way, this is a good sign that he will be back in the lineup for Monday night's game against Dallas.

news.body: Tony Pollard was not seen practicing on Thursday.
news.head: Tony Pollard not seen practicing Thursday
news.impact: It is unclear what the reasoning is for Pollard's absence. He'll need to be monitored on the injury report.

news.body: Tony Pollard carried the ball 25 times for 129 yards and three touchdowns while adding three catches for 26 yards in a 27-24 loss to the Browns in Week 7.
news.head: Tony Pollard scores three TDs in Week 7
news.impact: Pollard was one of the few bright spots for the Titans in Week 7. He got his team off to a fast start, ripping off a 36-yard touchdown run to cap off the Titans' first drive of the game. Pollard now has four rushing touchdowns on the year as he prepares to take on the Bengals in Week 8.

news.body: Tony Pollard ran 19 times for 76 yards in the Titans' 26-20 win over the Colts. He failed to bring in his only target.
news.head: Tony Pollard runs for 76 yards in win
news.impact: Pollard had the backfield virtually all to himself, aside from Tyjae Spears getting a single carry. A touchdown or some receiving work would have helped Pollard's bottom line tremendously, but it was not meant to be. If anything, his volume seems to be solid, so he's an RB3 with upside.

news.body: Tony Pollard (rest) returned to practice as a full participant on Thursday.
news.head: Tony Pollard (rest) returns to practice Thursday
news.impact: Pollard was given the day off on Wednesday as a veteran rest day, and he was able to make his return to practice as a full participant on Thursday. He should be good to go for Week 6 and will be primed for more work than usual if Tyjae Spears (knee) is limited or sidelined against the Colts on Sunday.

news.body: Travis Etienne Jr. (hamstring) has been placed on injured reserve and will be out for at least four weeks.
news.head: Travis Etienne Jr. (hamstring) placed on injured reserve
news.impact: The Saints have decided to place Etienne on injured reserve, which means that he is going to be sidelined for at least the next four weeks. He may be out longer than that as well, but the team has yet to place a concrete timetable on his recovery. Look for Alvin Kamara and Kendre Miller to both shoulder a much bigger workload in this backfield for the foreseeable future as a result of his absence.

news.body: Saints coach Kellen Moore said Travis Etienne Jr. “will miss time."
news.head: Travis Etienne Jr. (hamstring) to miss extended time
news.impact: Etienne does not hold a clear timetable to return. Alvin Kamara should take on a bigger role in the Saints backfield with Kendre Miller also taking on a bigger role behind him.

news.body: Travis Etienne Jr. exited Sunday’s contest between the New Orleans Saints against the Las Vegas Raiders according to Ross Jackson.
news.head: Travis Etienne Jr. exits early Sunday
news.impact: Etienne Jr. headed to the locker room for further evaluation, rushing 13 times for 57 yards while also hauling in both of his targets for 13 yards prior to exiting. Alvin Kamara and Kendre Miller will take over backfield duties in the running back’s absence.

news.body: Travis Etienne Jr. has been cleared for Sunday's game against the Raiders.
news.head: Travis Etienne Jr. (hamstring) good to go for Sunday
news.impact: Etienne has been dealing with a hamstring injury this week. He'll be a risky RB2 play for fantasy managers.

news.body: TreVeyon Henderson was not at practice on Thursday.
news.head: TreVeyon Henderson (ankle) not at practice Thursday
news.impact: Henderson was at practice on Wednesday. He will need to be monitored in practice on Thursday.

news.body: TreVeyon Henderson gained just nine yards on three carries and caught two passes for 14 yards in Thursday's 30-24 loss to the Bears.
news.head: TreVeyon Henderson gets just five touches in Week 7
news.impact: Henderson has now averaged just six touches per game over the last three weeks, and he's done very little with them. As surprising as it seems, Henderson's fantasy value is basically relegated to being a handcuff for veteran Rhamondre Stevenson at the moment.

news.body: TreVeyon Henderson rushed for 31 yards on seven carries in the 26-19 win over the Jets. He caught his lone target for nine yards.
news.head: TreVeyon Henderson logs eight touches in Week 6 win
news.impact: Henderson returned from a high-ankle sprain that he suffered last week, but saw Corey Kiner run the ball more Sunday. Henderson did fumble the ball to the Jets, which likely impacted his playing time late in the game. Henderson and the Patriots will take on the Bears in Week 7.

news.body: Patriots RB TreVeyon Henderson (ankle) is officially active for a Week 6 matchup with the Jets.
news.head: TreVeyon Henderson (ankle) officially active for Week 6
news.impact: Henderson was listed as questionable due to a high-ankle sprain he suffered last week. Even with Henderson active, Rhamondre Stevenson will likely see the bulk of the carries for the Patriots against the Jets.

news.body: Tyjae Spears missed practice again on Thursday.
news.head: Tyjae Spears (knee) not practicing Thursday
news.impact: Spears missed a second straight practice. He'll likely need to practice in some capacity on Friday to have a chance to play this weekend.

news.body: Tyjae Spears did not practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Tyjae Spears (knee) misses practice Wednesday
news.impact: Spears will need to be monitored in practice the rest of the week.

news.body: Titans RB Tyjae Spears (knee) is officially inactive for a Week 7 matchup with the Browns.
news.head: Tyjae Spears (knee) officially inactive for Week 7
news.impact: Spears continues to deal with a nagging knee injury that will keep him out this week. Tony Pollard will see the bulk of the touches out of the Titans' backfield, with Julius Chestnut serving as the backup.

news.body: Tyjae Spears (knee) is questionable to play in Sunday's game against the Cleveland Cavaliers.
news.head: Tyjae Spears (knee) questionable to play Sunday
news.impact: The Titans may not have Spears on Sunday, as he is currently considered questionable to play due to a nagging knee issue of some kind. If he's ruled out, Tony Pollard will dominate the touches in this backfield.

news.body: Tyler Allgeier did not practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Tyler Allgeier (toe) misses practice Wednesday
news.impact: Allgeier is dealing with a toe injury. Jeremiyah Love (ankle) returned to practice in a limited fashion on Wednesday.

news.body: Tyler Allgeier rushed eight times for 19 yards, while catching all three of his targets for 30 yards in the Cardinals' 30-16 loss to the Broncos in Week 7.
news.head: Tyler Allgeier Totals 49 Yards in Week 7
news.impact: Allgeier led Arizona's running backs with eight carries but averaged just 2.4 yards per attempt compared to 6.9 for Bam Knight. His three receptions helped salvage the afternoon, but neither back scored or reached 50 total yards. So, lean Knight or Allegeier next week.

news.body: Tyler Allgeier rushed the ball 18 times for 38 yards and caught one pass for ten yards in Sunday's 18-16 win over the Los Angeles Rams.
news.head: Tyler Allgeier inefficient in win Sunday
news.impact: Allgeier didn't look great on Sunday. He was projected to be a good fantasy option in the absence of rookie Jeremiyah Love (ankle), but he was only able to churn out 48 total yards on 20 opportunities. His efficiency continues to be his downfall, and fantasy managers shouldn't have too much hope that he will have significant value at any point this season.

news.body: Tyler Allgeier rushed the ball three times for seven yards and caught two passes for nine yards in Sunday's 45-21 loss to the Detroit Lions.
news.head: Tyler Allgeier quiet in loss Sunday
news.impact: Allgeier wasn't able to do much on Sunday. He logged just 16 total yards on his five touches, and he wasn't able to get into the end zone at all, which left him with a terrible fantasy total. He is unlikely to be fantasy relevant moving forward, besides being a handcuff option behind rookie Jeremiyah Love.

news.body: Woody Marks ran for 66 yards on 19 carries in the Texans 27-21 loss against the Giants. He also caught his lone target for 15 yards receiving.
news.head: Woody Marks totals 20 touches Sunday
news.impact: Marks was the clear workhorse on Sunday. He was unable to break off any big plays or find the end zone. The Texans will hope to get David Montgomery back following their bye week.

news.body: Woody Marks rushed for 56 yards on 15 carries in the Texans' 34-31 win over the Jaguars. He caught 2-of-3 targets for 25 yards.
news.head: Woody Marks sees 17 touches in Week 6 win
news.impact: Marks led the running back room in touches, but did see Jawhar Jordan score the lone rushing touchdown for Houston. Fantasy managers should expect Marks and Jordan to continue to get work if David Montgomery (groin) is forced to miss more time.

news.body: Woody Marks will reportedly "carry the load" for the Texans with David Montgomery week-to-week with a groin injury.
news.head: Woody Marks will 'carry the load' for Texans with Montgomery out
news.impact: Marks had 19 touches on Sunday and he operated as the Texans lead back in 2025, so this is nothing new to him. He's not overly dynamic, despite the coachspeak, but he can get it done for fantasy thanks to volume. He's a low-end RB2, high-end RB3 with the backfield to himself.

news.body: Woody Marks ran for 62 yards on 15 carries in the Texans 26-3 win over the Titans. He also caught 4-of-4 targets for 23 yards receiving.
news.head: Woody Marks sees 19 touches Sunday
news.impact: Marks was the lead back for Houston most of the afternoon after David Montgomery injured his groin and did not return. He had a 20 yard touchdown taken off the board due to a holding penalty. He'll be an RB2 play next week against the Jaguars.

news.body: Zach Charbonnet (knee) will not play Sunday night against the Chiefs.
news.head: Zach Charbonnet (knee) will not play in Week 7
news.impact: There was some speculation that Charbonnet would make his long-awaited return for the Seahawks on Sunday night, but that will not be the case. Charbonnet was activated from the PUP list this past Thursday and should be ready to go for a Monday night matchup against the Bears in Week 8.

news.body: Zach Charbonnet has been activated from the PUP list by the Seahawks. It’s a big jump forward in his return to play.
news.head: Zach Charbonnet activated from PUP list on Thursday
news.impact: Charbonnet seems likely to play in Week 7 against Kansas City, and good timing as the Seahawks desperately need a running game. However, don’t expect a big workload to start, as he is still working his way back to full health from a major injury. He’s certainly worth monitoring and keeping an eye on. If he’s on waivers, he’s worth a stash.

news.body: Zach Charbonnet was a full participant in practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Zach Charbonnet (knee) logs full practice Wednesday
news.impact: Charbonnet remains on track to make his season debut on Sunday against the Chiefs.

news.body: Zach Charbonnet remains on track to play "in some capacity" in Week 7 against the Chiefs.
news.head: Zach Charbonnet (knee) on track to play 'in some capacity' in Week 7
news.impact: Charbonnet will continue to practice all week. He'll have to be activated by Thursday, which will be 21 days after they designated him to return to practice. His status will need to be monitored in practice throughout the week.

news.body: AJ Barner caught four of his five targets for 42 yards in a 20-3 win over the Chiefs in Week 7.
news.head: AJ Barner goes for 42 yards in Week 7
news.impact: Barner finished second on the Seahawks in targets, catches, and receiving in the impressive win against the previously undefeated Chiefs. The veteran tight end has 19 catches for 180 yards and zero touchdowns through seven games this year. He will be a TE2 in fantasy in Week 8 vs. the Bears.

news.body: AJ Barner caught three of four targets for 16 yards in the Seahawks' 17-14 loss to the Broncos on Thursday.
news.head: AJ Barner catches three passes in loss
news.impact: Barner hasn't really gotten going this season after showing a lot of promise in 2025. The ability is there; we saw it back in Week 3 against Washington, but the opportunity hasn't been. He's not startable in fantasy right now.

news.body: AJ Barner caught 3-of-5 targets for 20 yards in the Seahawks 32-29 loss against the 49ers.
news.head: AJ Barner catches three passes Sunday
news.impact: Barner remains off the fantasy radar in his current role.

news.body: AJ Barner caught 1-of-3 targets for 12 yards in the Seahawks 30-23 win over the Chargers.
news.head: AJ Barner quiet Sunday
news.impact: Barner was coming off a big performance last week. He remains a volatile TE2 for fantasy managers.

news.body: Brenton Strange was a full participant in practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Brenton Strange (eye) logs full practice Wednesday
news.impact: Strange will be good to go for Sunday's game against the Colts. He remains in the low-end TE1 range for fantasy managers.

news.body: Brenton Strange caught 5-of-7 targets for 44 yards in the 34-31 loss to the Texans.
news.head: Brenton Strange catches five passes in Week 6 loss
news.impact: Strange continues to lead the tight end group for the Jaguars. The 25-year-old has logged three straight games with at least five receptions. Strange and the Jaguars will head to the bye in Week 7.

news.body: Brenton Strange secured 7-of-8 targets for 68 yards in Sunday's 19-17 win over the Eagles.
news.head: Brenton Strange leads Jaguars in catches for second straight week
news.impact: Strange has now come up with seven receptions in two straight games, leading all Jaguars both times. He's hauled in 14 of 16 passes overall in that span, gaining 163 yards in the process. Strange has not found the end zone since Week 1, but he has been close a couple of times, including in this win against the Eagles. He's rapidly climbing up the TE ranks in his fourth NFL season.

news.body: Brenton Strange hauled in 7-of-8 targets for 95 yards in Sunday's 22-17 win over the Cincinnati Bengals.
news.head: Brenton Strange leads team in receiving Sunday
news.impact: The veteran tight end stepped up on Sunday. He finished as the team's top receiver with 95 yards against the Bengals, which was very timely on an afternoon where most of their receiving options were struggling. He had a good fantasy total in this game, but managers shouldn't expect this to be a regular thing for him moving forward.

news.body: Brock Bowers was limited in practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Brock Bowers (calf) limited in practice Wednesday
news.impact: Warren notes that Bowers was also limited last Wednesday then was a full participant in practice the next two days.

news.body: Brock Bowers caught six of his eight targets for 73 yards in the Raiders' 35-21 Week 7 loss to the Los Angeles Rams.
news.head: Brock Bowers catches six passes in Week 7 loss
news.impact: Bowers has made the most of his opportunities in an inconsistent passing attack, finishing with 70 or more receiving yards in each of his five contests. The tight end remains one of the more reliable-pass catching options in the Raiders offense ahead of a Week 8 contest against the New York Jets.

news.body: Brock Bowers (hamstring/calf) is practicing Friday for the Las Vegas Raiders according to Sam Warren.
news.head: Brock Bowers (hamstring/calf) practicing Friday
news.impact: Bowers logged another full practice session after suffering the hamstring and calf injuries earlier in the week, putting the tight end in line as one of the more dynamic weapons in the Raiders offense against a banged-up Rams defense in Week 7.

news.body: Brock Bowers (hamstring/calf) was upgraded to a full participant at practice on Thursday.
news.head: Brock Bowers (hamstring/calf) upgraded to full participant Thursday
news.impact: Bowers was limited on Wednesday due to a pair of minor injuries that he's managing, but he was upgraded to a full participant on Thursday and will be good to go for Week 7. He will continue to be a top-tier fantasy option at the position for as long as he remains healthy and on the field moving forward.

news.body: Cade Otton failed to haul in his only target in the Buccaneers' 43-13 win over the Panthers on Sunday.
news.head: Cade Otton silent in Sunday win
news.impact: Otton was running wind sprints once again, and now has just three targets and four receiving yards to his name over the last two weekends of football. He's best left on waivers right now, as his value has primarily been when the Bucs are without any notable receivers.

news.body: Cade Otton caught 1-of-2 targets for four yards in the Buccaneers 26-19 loss against the Steelers.
news.head: Cade Otton quiet Sunday
news.impact: Otton remains off the fantasy radar with Jalon Daniels behind center.

news.body: Cade Otton caught three of four targets for 25 yards in the Bucs' 24-16 win over the Cowboys on Thursday.
news.head: Cade Otton catches three passes in win
news.impact: Otton had two of his three catches on the first drive, and wasn't heard from much afterwards. The passing offense under Jaylon Daniels is still effective, just not explosive. Things get done, but maybe not in a fantasy-friendly manner. That's going to hurt Otton's fantasy value until something changes.

news.body: Cade Otton caught four of his six targets for 37 yards in a 17-14 loss to the Packers in Week 4.
news.head: Cade Otton leads Bucs in receiving in Week 4
news.impact: Otton was busy in quarterback Jalon Daniels' NFL debut, serving as a safety valve for the rookie. The veteran tight end has drawn exactly six targets in three straight games for Tampa. Overall, he has 15 catches for 157 yards through four games. He will be a low-end TE2 in Week 5 vs. the Cowboys.

news.body: Chig Okonkwo caught all seven of his targets for 69 yards in a 23-17 loss to the 49ers in Week 6.
news.head: Chig Okonkwo goes for seven catches, 69 yards in Week 6
news.impact: Okonkwo led the Commanders in receiving in the close loss on Monday night. The veteran tight end has caught at least four passes while reaching at least 60 yards in two straight games. He could be in store for a larger role after his bye in Week 7, as Terry McLaurin was carted off the field on Monday vs. the 49ers with a knee injury.

news.body: Chig Okonkwo caught four of his team-high six targets for 60 yards in the Commanders' 27-27 Week 5 tie with the New York Giants.
news.head: Chig Okonkwo catches four passes in Week 5 tie
news.impact: Okonkwo was impactful in the rain-soaked Week 5 contest for head coach Dan Quinn, recording over 50 receiving yards for the first time in his three contests. The tight end remains another risky pass-catching option in all formats ahead of a Week 6 contest against the San Francisco 49ers.

news.body: Chig Okonkwo (hamstring) was listed as a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
news.head: Chig Okonkwo (hamstring) listed as limited Thursday
news.impact: The veteran tight end was able to log another limited practice session on Thursday. His hamstring injury isn't serious at this point, however, and he is expected to play through it in this week's matchup against the Giants.

news.body: Chig Okonkwo (hamstring) was listed as a limited participant at practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Chig Okonkwo (hamstring) listed as limited Wednesday
news.impact: Okonkwo was able to make his return to the lineup in Week 4 after missing a bit of time due to a hamstring injury. It's not surprising that the team continues to limit his workload at practice because of it, but he still should be good to play through it in Week 5, assuming he doesn't re-aggravate the injury sometime during the week.

news.body: Colby Parkinson did not practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Colby Parkinson (ribs) misses practice Wednesday
news.impact: Parkinson has played a bigger role in recent weeks. He will need to be monitored in practice the rest of the week.

news.body: Colby Parkinson caught five of his six targets for 48 yards in the Rams' 35-21 win over the Las Vegas Raiders in Week 7.
news.head: Colby Parkinson sees six targets in Week 7 win
news.impact: Parkinson made the most of increased usage in the Los Angeles passing attack, recording over 40 receiving yards for the first time in his six contests. The tight end remains another risky option in a Los Angeles passing attack led by superstar wideout Puka Nacua ahead of a Week 8 contest against the Los Angeles Chargers.

news.body: Colby Parkinson hauled in 5-of-6 targets for 31 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 18-16 loss to the Arizona Cardinals.
news.head: Colby Parkinson hauls in touchdown Sunday
news.impact: The veteran was a bright spot for the Rams on Sunday. He was able to catch one of their two touchdowns over the course of the afternoon, but they still suffered an ugly loss at the hands of the Cardinals. Fantasy managers shouldn't be expecting him to produce in a consistent manner moving forward.

news.body: Colby Parkinson is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Cardinals.
news.head: Colby Parkinson (shoulder) off injury report Sunday
news.impact: Parkinson closed the week with a full practice on Friday.

news.body: Colston Loveland hauled in 7-of-12 targets for 69 yards and a touchdown in Thursday's 30-24 win over the Patriots.
news.head: Colston Loveland finds the end zone again in Week 7
news.impact: Those who have been patient with Loveland after a frustratingly slow start to the season are now being rewarded. With Caleb Williams back in the huddle for the last two games, Loveland has looked like the No. 1 option in the Bears' passing attack. The second-year TE has caught 13 of 19 targets for 134 yards and a pair of touchdowns in that span. Loveland should remain a strong TE1 the rest of the way.

news.body: Colston Loveland hauled in six of his seven targets for 65 yards and one touchdown in the Bears' 31-23 Week 6 win over the Atlanta Falcons.
news.head: Colston Loveland finds end zone in Week 6 win
news.impact: Loveland has made the most of increased opportunities in the Chicago passing attack of late, recording four or more receptions in three of the last four contests. The tight end will look for another impactful performance against the New England Patriots in Week 7.

news.body: Colston Loveland caught two of his five targets for 19 yards in the Bears' 31-7 loss to the Green Bay Packers in Week 5.
news.head: Colston Loveland quiet in Week 5 loss
news.impact: Loveland has seen inconsistent involvement in the Chicago passing attack to begin the season, recording two receptions or less in three of the first five contests. The tight end remains difficult to trust in all formats ahead of a Week 6 contest against the Atlanta Falcons.

news.body: Colston Loveland caught six of his nine targets for 57 yards in a 23-12 win over the Jets in Week 4.
news.head: Colston Loveland goes for 57 yards in Week 4
news.impact: Loveland turned in his best game of the season, leading the Bears in catches and targets. It was a welcome sight after he had just five catches through the first three games. The second-year tight end now has 11 catches for 91 scoreless yards in four games. He will be on the TE1 radar in Week 5 against Green Bay.

news.body: Dallas Goedert hauled in 5-of-7 targets for 48 yards in Monday night's 38-21 loss to the Dallas Cowboys.
news.head: Dallas Goedert hauls in five passes Monday
news.impact: The veteran played pretty well on Monday. He hauled in five passes over the course of the game and was able to turn that into 48 yards, but he didn't get into the end zone at all, which left him with a mediocre fantasy finish in most league formats. He will likely continue to be startable moving forward, especially if DeVonta Smith (hamstring) misses more time.

news.body: Dallas Goedert (knee) is not taking part in Philadelphia's practice on Friday.
news.head: Dallas Goedert (knee) not practicing Friday
news.impact: The veteran tight end is not practicing for the Eagles again on Friday. He will have one more chance to log at least a limited practice on Saturday before the team's game on Monday night, but if he's not able to, it's likely that he will be sidelined for the team's primetime matchup against Dallas in Week 7.

news.body: Dallas Goedert (knee) did not take part in Philadelphia's practice on Thursday.
news.head: Dallas Goedert (knee) doesn't practice Thursday
news.impact: The Eagles let Goedert sit out of their first practice of the week on Thursday. It seems to be just for injury management purposes, but fantasy managers should continue to keep tabs on his status throughout the week to ensure that he will be available to play on Monday night. His fantasy value will be questionable this week even if he's healthy, however, with QB Tanner McKee set to be the starter for the Eagles moving forward.

news.body: Philadelphia Eagles tight end Dallas Goedert caught six of his eight targets for 61 yards in a losing effort against the Carolina Panthers.
news.head: Dallas Goedert logs 61 yards in Week 6
news.impact: Goedert has been heavily involved since his return from injury. Over the last two weeks, he has had a combined 17 targets. In Week 5, he had an inefficient 38 yards, but he eclipsed 60 yards for the second time in four games played. With Tanner McKee as the starter for the foreseeable future, their chemistry in Week 6 is notable.

news.body: Dalton Kincaid was limited in practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Dalton Kincaid (chest) limited in practice Wednesday
news.impact: Kincaid is on track to be good to go for Sunday's game against the Ravens. He'll remain a TE1 play for fantasy managers.

news.body: Dalton Kincaid hauled on 7-of-8 passing attempts for 38 yards in Sunday's 33-30 win over the Las Vegas Raiders.
news.head: Dalton Kincaid hauls in seven passes Sunday
news.impact: Kincaid saw a lot of involvement on Sunday, leading the team with eight targets and seven catches in a win over the Raiders. He wasn't able to do much with his work, however, racking up just 38 scoreless yards over the course of the game. It's encouraging to see them take pains to get him involved, but it's still hard to trust starting him in most fantasy formats at this point in the season.

news.body: Dalton Kincaid caught one of his two targets for a seven-yard gain and added a two-point conversion catch in a 37-34 overtime win over the Rams in Week 5.
news.head: Dalton Kincaid catches one pass in Week 5
news.impact: Kincaid was quiet on Monday night, his second straight slow outing. After starting the season hot, Kincaid has just two catches for 14 yards over his past two contests. Overall, the veteran tight end has 16 catches for 277 yards and one touchdown through five games. He will be a low-end TE1 in Week 6 against the Raiders.

news.body: Dalton Kincaid caught 1-of-2 targets for seven yards in the loss to the Patriots.
news.head: Dalton Kincaid quiet in Week 4
news.impact: Kincaid set new season lows in all receiving metrics in the loss Sunday. Fantasy managers will hope that Kincaid bounces back in a Week 5 matchup against the Rams.

news.body: Darren Waller caught one of two targets for a 50-yard touchdown in the Panthers' 43-13 loss to the Buccaneers on Sunday,
news.head: Darren Waller catches long TD in loss to Tampa
news.impact: If you have to only catch one ball, you might as well make it count. Waller rewarded those who started him with a long 50-yard score before going silent for the rest of the way. He's a risky start in fantasy despite some initial optimism for his role,

news.body: Carolina Panthers tight end Darren Waller did not record a reception on two targets in a Week 6 win over Philadelphia.
news.head: Darren Waller blanked in Week 6
news.impact: Waller's two targets were his fewest since Week 1. He had 14 between Weeks 3 and 4 heading into a Week 5 bye, but tight end Tommy Tremble got involved with two touchdowns in Week 6. The Panthers' offense has been potent, but Tremble has been involved as well with 11 catches in the last three games.

news.body: Darren Waller (toe) was limited at practice again on Thursday.
news.head: Darren Waller (toe) limited again Thursday
news.impact: The veteran tight end was a limited participant for another practice on Thursday. His toe injury doesn't seem to be a serious issue, but there's always a chance that it will leave him out for a week. Tommy Tremble (rib) would see more work if that's the case.

news.body: Darren Waller (toe) was limited at practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Darren Waller (toe) limited at practice Wednesday
news.impact: Carolina left the veteran limited at practice on Wednesday. They are likely trying to limit his workload early on in the week, so fantasy managers shouldn't be too concerned with his availability for Week 6 at this point, unless he's downgraded at some point later on in the week.

news.body: George Kittle hauled in 8-of-10 targets for 88 yards in Sunday's 29-20 loss to the Falcons.
news.head: George Kittle leads 49ers in receiving Sunday
news.impact: With both Mike Evans and Deebo Samuel out, Kittle put up new season highs in receptions, targets, and receiving yards on Sunday. The veteran TE is averaging just under five grabs for more than 60 yards per game with five touchdowns through seven weeks. Kittle remains among the top fantasy assets at TE.

news.body: George Kittle caught five of his eight targets for 69 yards and a touchdown in a 23-17 win over the Commanders in Week 6.
news.head: George Kittle finds the end zone in Week 6
news.impact: Kittle finished second on the 49ers in receiving yards and catches in the close win on Monday night. The veteran tight end scored his touchdown on an 11-yard pass from Brock Purdy early in the first quarter. Overall, Kittle has 26 catches for 337 yards and five touchdowns through six games for the 49ers. With Mike Evans (Achilles soreness) expected to be held out through the team's Week 8 bye, Kittle will be a top-five fantasy tight end option in Week 7 vs. the Falcons.

news.body: George Kittle caught 5-of-6 targets for 24 yards in the 49ers 32-29 win over the Seahawks.
news.head: George Kittle catches five passes Sunday
news.impact: Kittle was used as a dump off pass catcher from Brock Purdy all afternoon. He'll look to bounce back next week against the Commanders.

news.body: 49ers TE George Kittle (illness) is officially active for a Week 5 matchup with the Seahawks.
news.head: George Kittle (illness) officially active for Week 5
news.impact: It was announced that Kittle was dealing with an illness, but the star tight end will suit up and play Sunday. Kittle should slot in as a TE1 this week despite the illness.

news.body: Greg Dulcich was limited in practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Greg Dulcich (ankle) limited in practice Wednesday
news.impact: Dulcich will remain a TE2 play for fantasy managers.

news.body: Greg Dulcich caught 5-of-5 targets for 86 yards in the Dolphins' 28-25 win over the Jets.
news.head: Greg Dulcich hauls in five passes in Week 7 win
news.impact: Dulcich led the team in receptions, targets, and receiving yards Sunday. The veteran tight end should remain a key component in the Dolphins' offense in Week 8 against New England.

news.body: Greg Dulcich caught 4-of-5 targets for 37 yards in Sunday's 31-24 loss to the Cincinnati Bengals.
news.head: Greg Dulcich catches four passes Sunday
news.impact: The veteran tight end was able to get involved on Sunday, catching four passes just a week after being held without a catch against the Vikings. He wasn't able to put up a good fantasy total on Sunday, however, and fantasy managers should have low expectations for him moving forward.

news.body: Greg Dulcich did not record a single target or touch in Sunday's 15-10 loss to the Minnesota Vikings.
news.head: Greg Dulcich doesn't catch pass Sunday
news.impact: The veteran was a complete non-factor on Sunday. He didn't log a single target or touch against the Vikings, which was rather surprising after he caught five passes last week. He remains off of the fantasy radar moving forward.

news.body: Harold Fannin Jr. caught six of his nine targets for 91 yards in a 27-24 win over the Titans in Week 7.
news.head: Harold Fannin Jr. hauls in six passes in Week 7
news.impact: Fannin set a season-high in receiving yardage in the close win. The second-year tight end made the play of the day on a 36-yard catch-and-run late in the fourth quarter to set up the eventual game-winning field goal. Fannin will be a low-end TE1 in Week 8 against Pittsburgh.

news.body: Cleveland Browns tight end Harold Fannin Jr. was limited to one reception for nine yards on three targets in Week 6.
news.head: Harold Fannin Jr. catches one pass in Week 6
news.impact: Fannin had his second consecutive week with just one catch after averaging 5.0 receptions and 1.0 touchdowns from Weeks 2-4. Deshaun Watson has been held to under 175 passing yards in three of the last four weeks, putting a lid on the team's aerial output.

news.body: Harold Fannin Jr. caught one of his four targets for four yards in a 17-12 loss to the Jets in Week 5.
news.head: Harold Fannin Jr. held to one catch in Week 5
news.impact: It was the first time in Fannin's 21-game NFL career that he was held to fewer than two catches, although a rainy afternoon at MetLife Stadium may have played into the slow outing. The second-year tight end now has 18 catches for 157 yards and three touchdowns through five games. He will look to bounce back at home in Week 6 against the Ravens.

news.body: Harold Fannin Jr. came up with 3-of-5 targets for 27 yards and a touchdown in Thursday's 27-24 win over the Steelers.
news.head: Harold Fannin Jr. finds the end zone again in Week 4
news.impact: After scoring twice in Week 3, Fannin hauled in another touchdown toss from Deshaun Watson on Thursday night. Fannin did not start off great in a season-opening loss to the Jaguars, but during the Browns' current three-game winning streak, the second-year pro has totaled 15 grabs for 132 yards. Fannin is cementing his TE1 status.

news.body: Hunter Henry hauled in all seven of his targets for 71 yards in Thursday's 30-24 loss to the Bears.
news.head: Hunter Henry leads Patriots in receptions Thursday night
news.impact: Henry led all Patriots pass catchers in targets and receptions Thursday night. The veteran remains a reliable option for QB Drake Maye, as he's caught at least three passes and gone over 40 yards in each of the past four weeks. Henry has also scored twice in that span.

news.body: Hunter Henry caught 4-of-5 targets for 48 yards and a touchdown in a 26-19 win over the Jets.
news.head: Hunter Henry hits pay dirt in Week 6 win
news.impact: Henry has found the endzone in two consecutive games and logged at least four targets or more in four of his last five games. Henry remains a trustworthy option heading into a Week 7 matchup with the Bears.

news.body: Hunter Henry caught 3-of-4 targets for 44 yards and a touchdown in the Patriots win over the Raiders.
news.head: Hunter Henry hauls in three passes in Week 5
news.impact: Henry found the end zone on an 11-yard touchdown reception late in the second quarter. This marks Henry's first touchdown of the season and gives Henry back-to-back-games with four or more targets. Henry and the Patriots will take on the Jets in Week 6.

news.body: Hunter Henry caught all five of his targets for 62 yards in the Patriots win over the Bills.
news.head: Hunter Henry hauls in five passes in Week 4 win
news.impact: Henry led the team in receiving yards, and caught the pass to seal the win late in the fourth quarter. His five receptions and 62 yards mark new season highs for the veteran. Henry will look to build on this performance against the Raiders in Week 5.

news.body: Isaiah Likely caught 2-of-4 targets for 12 yards in the Giants 27-21 win over the Giants.
news.head: Isaiah Likely quiet Sunday
news.impact: Likely was not involved much in the first career start for J.J. McCarthy. He still remains a TE1 heading into the Giants bye week.

news.body: Isaiah Likely caught 6-of-11 targets for 99 yards and a touchdown in the Giants 34-27 loss against the Saints.
news.head: Isaiah Likely hauls in touchdown Sunday
news.impact: Likely continued his success at finding the end zone. He nearly caught a second one as J.J. McCarthy just missed looking to find him to tie the game at the end of the game. He remains a locked in TE1.

news.body: Isaiah Likely is practicing in full for Week 6 against the Saints.
news.head: Isaiah Likely (foot) practicing in full for Week 6
news.impact: Likely remains a strong TE1 for fantasy managers.

news.body: Isaiah Likely hauled in 11 of his 13 targets for 94 yards and two touchdowns in the Giants' 27-27 tie with the Washington Commanders in Week 5.
news.head: Isaiah Likely hauls in two touchdowns in Week 5 tie with Commanders
news.impact: Likely has made the most of his involvement in the New York passing attack to this point, recording over 65 receiving yards in three of the first five games. The tight end remains one of the more impactful options in the Giants offense early on for new head coach John Harbaugh ahead of a Week 6 matchup against the New Orleans Saints.

news.body: Jake Ferguson failed to catch his lone target in Monday night's 38-21 win over the Philadelphia Eagles.
news.head: Jake Ferguson catchless in win Monday
news.impact: The veteran had a goose egg on Monday night, finishing the game with zero catches and just one target. This performance burned any fantasy managers who started him, and he remains a risky option on a week-to-week basis moving forward.

news.body: Jake Ferguson caught two of his three targets for 13 yards in a 23-13 loss to the Packers in Week 6.
news.head: Jake Ferguson held to two catches in Week 6
news.impact: Ferguson was held in check by the Packers in the loss as the Cowboys leaned on CeeDee Lamb and George Pickens in the passing attack. Ferguson is putting together a pedestrian season, posting just 17 catches for 115 yards and three touchdowns in six games. He will be a high-end TE2 in Week 7 vs. Philadelphia.

news.body: Jake Ferguson caught three of six targets for 19 yards in the Cowboys' 24-16 loss to Tampa Bay on Thursday.
news.head: Jake Ferguson has critical drop in loss to Bucs
news.impact: Ferguson had a critical drop on the Cowboys' final drive as they were trying to tie the game, failing to catch a pass and instead bobbling it straight up and into the arms of LB Alex Anzalone. It was a tough night for the veteran, but better days will come.

news.body: Jake Ferguson caught 3-of-4 targets for 11 yards in the Cowboys 34-30 win over the Texans.
news.head: Jake Ferguson quiet Sunday
news.impact: Ferguson spent most of the afternoon blocking against the Texans pass rush. He remains a touchdown dependent tight end on a week-to-week basis.

news.body: Kyle Pitts Sr. hauled in all five of his targets for 22 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 29-20 win over the 49ers.
news.head: Kyle Pitts Sr. hits paydirt again in Week 7 win
news.impact: For those who were patient with Pitts after a very slow start this season, the rewards have come over the last three weeks. The towering tight end has now scored four times during that span, catching exactly five passes each time out.

news.body: Kyle Pitts Sr. hauled in five of his seven targets for 60 yards and two touchdowns in the Falcons' 31-23 Week 6 loss to the Chicago Bears.
news.head: Kyle Pitts Sr. hauls in two touchdowns in Week 6 loss to Bears
news.impact: Pitts Sr. has made the most of the return of quarterback Michael Penix Jr., recording five receptions and one or more touchdowns in each of the last two contests. The tight end remains one of the primary pass-catching options for head coach Kevin Stefanski as long as Penix Jr. is behind center ahead of a Week 7 matchup against the San Francisco 49ers.

news.body: Kyle Pitts Sr. brought down 5-of-6 targets for 42 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 30-23 OT loss to the Ravens.
news.head: Kyle Pitts Sr. hauls in first touchdown of the season
news.impact: After being a non-factor over the first three weeks of the season, Pitts has asserted himself the last two games. Over the last two weeks, Pitts has caught eight passes for 89 yards and hit paydirt for the first time Sunday night. Unfortunately, QB Michael Penix's (ribs) health is once again in question, so Pitts is a real question mark at tight end for fantasy purposes.

news.body: Kyle Pitts Sr. caught three passes for 47 yards in Monday night's 45-24 win over the New Orleans Saints.
news.head: Kyle Pitts Sr. racks up 47 yards Monday
news.impact: Pitts has had a very rough start to the season from a fantasy perspective, and it didn't get much better on Monday. He was able to rack up 47 yards at least, but he only caught three passes and failed to get into the end zone at all. He shouldn't be trusted as a starter for the foreseeable future.

news.body: Mark Andrews caught 3-of-4 targets for 23 yards in a 35-13 loss to the Bengals.
news.head: Mark Andrews hauls in three passes in Week 7
news.impact: Andrews led the tight end group in targets and receptions in the loss to the Bengals. Andrews has not seen the same target share with Tyler Huntley at quarterback, so it would be a welcome sight for fantasy managers if Lamar Jackson is able to play in Week 8.

news.body: Baltimore Ravens tight end Mark Andrews caught just one pass for four yards in the Week 6 road loss against the Cleveland Browns
news.head: Mark Andrews quiet in Week 6 loss
news.impact: Andrews saw a season-low three targets in a tight contest with rookie tight end Josh Cuevas catching the lone touchdown of the night. The veteran has been held under 30 yards for four consecutive weeks while providing a low-end fantasy output.

news.body: Mark Andrews secured 4-of-6 targets for 28 yards in Sunday's 30-23 OT win against the Falcons.
news.head: Mark Andrews grabs four passes in Week 5 win
news.impact: Andrews limited PPR contribution was diminished by a lost fumble Sunday night. The veteran TE finished behind wide receivers Zay Flowers and Rashod Bateman in both catches and yards. Andrews is still a significant factor in the Ravens' offense, as he's caught 22 passes through five games. However, he's scored just once and is averaging barely over 8.0 yards per reception.

news.body: Mark Andrews caught 5-of-6 targets for 27 yards and a touchdown in the Ravens win over the Titans.
news.head: Mark Andrews finds the end zone in Week 4 win
news.impact: Andrews caught a three-yard touchdown pass late in the second quarter to extend the Ravens' lead. This marked the veteran's first trip to the end zone this season. Andrews will look to build on this performance against the Falcons in Week 5.

news.body: Mason Taylor caught 5-of-6 targets for 62 yards and two touchdowns in a 28-25 loss to the Dolphins.
news.head: Mason Taylor hits pay dirt twice in Week 7 loss
news.impact: Taylor has seen six targets in back-to-back games for the Jets and accounted for two of the team's three touchdowns Sunday. Taylor appears to be more trusted than Kenyon Sadiq by Geno Smith, leaving Taylor as the better option heading into Week 8.

news.body: Mason Taylor caught 4-of-6 targets for 33 yards in a 26-19 loss to the Patriots.
news.head: Mason Taylor hauls in four passes in Week 6 loss
news.impact: Taylor led the tight end group in receptions, yards, and targets. Taylor and Kenyon Sadiq should be expected to continue to split time heading into Week 7.

news.body: Mason Taylor caught all three of his targets for 24 yards in a 17-12 win over the Browns in Week 5.
news.head: Mason Taylor catches three passes in Week 5
news.impact: Taylor finished third on the Jets in receiving in the close win after missing the previous three games with a thumb injury. He might be in line for a larger role in Week 6 vs. the Patriots with Kenyon Sadiq suffering a concussion in Week 5's win.

news.body: Mason Taylor (thumb) will be active for Sunday's game against the Browns.
news.head: Mason Taylor (thumb) to return Sunday
news.impact: Taylor has missed each of the last two weeks due to a thumb injury, but the second-year TE will be back for Sunday's game. Jeremy Ruckert and Jelani Woods figure to see fewer snaps as a result.

news.body: Michael Mayer caught all three of his targets for 32 yards in the Raiders’ 35-21 loss to the Rams in Week 7.
news.head: Michael Mayer catches three passes in Week 7
news.impact: Mayer has seen inconsistent involvement in the Las Vegas passing attack of late, receiving three targets or less in three of his last five contests. The tight end remains difficult to trust in all formats as long as Brock Bowers remains healthy, with a Week 8 contest against the New York Jets up next.

news.body: Michael Mayer hauled in 7-of-9 targets for 95 yards in Sunday's 33-30 loss to the Buffalo Bills.
news.head: Michael Mayer hauls in seven passes Sunday
news.impact: Mayer had a great performance on Sunday. He set a new career high in receiving yards against the Bills, racking up 95 on his seven catches, which left him with a great fantasy total. He may have some good games here or there moving forward, but he's unlikely to be a reliable week-to-week asset with TE Brock Bowers still easily ahead of him in the pecking order at this point.

news.body: Michael Mayer caught his lone target for two yards in a loss to the Patriots.
news.head: Michael Mayer disappears in Week 5 loss
news.impact: Mayer's one target set a new season low for the 25-year-old tight end. With Brock Bowers continuing to dominate the target share, Mayer is tough to trust in Week 6 against Buffalo.

news.body: Michael Mayer caught eight of his 10 targets for 82 yards in a 30-27 loss to the Chiefs in Week 4.
news.head: Michael Mayer goes for 82 yards in Week 4
news.impact: Mayer finished second on the team in receiving behind only Brock Bowers. His involvement alongside Bowers has been encouraging as Mayer caught a touchdown back in Week 3. Mayer is worth a look as a tight end streamer in deeper fantasy leagues going forward. He will face the Patriots in Week 5.

news.body: Mike Gesicki caught his lone target for six yards and a touchdown in a 35-13 win over the Ravens.
news.head: Mike Gesicki hits pay dirt in Week 7
news.impact: Gesicki found the end zone in the third quarter to open the scoring for the Bengals on their way to a comeback win. The veteran tight end has five touchdowns in six games so far this season. Gesicki and the Bengals will take on the Titans in Week 8.

news.body: Mike Gesicki caught 1-of-2 targets for four yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 31-24 win over the Miami Dolphins.
news.head: Mike Gesicki finds end zone Sunday
news.impact: Gesicki was pretty uninvolved on Sunday in general, but he was able to leave his mark on the game by connecting with QB Joe Burrow on a short four-yard touchdown. He still didn't end with a good fantasy total, however, and should not be started in most leagues moving forward.

news.body: Mike Gesicki caught 3-of-5 targets for 40 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 22-17 loss to the Jacksonville Jaguars.
news.head: Mike Gesicki catches touchdown in loss Sunday
news.impact: The veteran had an pretty good game on Sunday. He finished with 40 yards and a touchdown against the Jaguars, although that wasn't enough to help the Bengals pick up a win at home. Gesicki may be a great fantasy option in Week 5 with Ja'Marr Chase (concussion) and Tee Higgins (adductor) both at serious risk of missing time.

news.body: Mike Gesicki caught 3-of-3 targets for 37 yards and a touchdown in a 30-27 loss to the Steelers.
news.head: Mike Gesicki finds the end zone in Week 3 loss
news.impact: Gesicki had a much needed bounce back performance after failing to record a target in Week 2. He tallied his second touchdown of the season on a 25-yard touchdown reception early in the fourth quarter. Gesicki will look to build on this performance in Week 4 against Jacksonville.

news.body: Pat Freiermuth caught two of four targets for 20 yards in the Steelers' 16-10 win over the Saints on Sunday.
news.head: Pat Freiermuth held to two catches in win
news.impact: After two games with a combined three touchdowns, Freiermuth has just four receptions for 31 yards in the last two games. He's a risky streaming tight end at best.

news.body: Pat Freiermuth caught 2-of-3 targets for 11 yards in the Steelers 26-19 win over the Buccaneers.
news.head: Pat Freiermuth quiet Sunday
news.impact: Freiermuth was playing through a calf injury that landed him on the injury report right before Sunday. He'll be more reliable if he can practice fully next week.

news.body: Steelers TE Pat Freiermuth (calf) is officially active for a Week 6 matchup with Tampa Bay.
news.head: Pat Freiermuth (calf) officially active for Week 6
news.impact: Freiermuth was a late addition to the injury report this week, but has been cleared to play after pregame warmups. The veteran has appeared more involved in the offense as of late, scoring three touchdowns in his last two games.

news.body: Pat Freiermuth has been added to the injury report as questionable for Sunday’s game against the Buccaneers.
news.head: Pat Freiermuth (calf) now questionable Sunday
news.impact: Freiermuth was a late addition to the injury report with a calf injury. His status will need to be monitored Sunday morning.

news.body: Sam LaPorta caught 1-of-2 targets for just 18 yards in Sunday's 20-17 win over the Green Bay Packers.
news.head: Sam LaPorta disappoints in win Sunday
news.impact: LaPorta had a disappointing performance on Sunday. He was only able to catch one pass over the course of the entire game, and he was only able to rack up 18 scoreless yards on it, which left him with a poor fantasy total. He should bounce back in the near future, though he will remain prone to bad showings in the future.

news.body: Sam LaPorta caught five passes for 88 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 45-21 win over the Arizona Cardinals.
news.head: Sam LaPorta stellar in win Sunday
news.impact: LaPorta looked great again on Sunday, finishing as Detroit's leading receiver with 88 yards and a touchdown on five catches against the Cardinals. He has been playing very well and remains a must-start fantasy option for the time being.

news.body: Sam LaPorta caught 8-of-13 targets for 84 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 32-26 loss to the Panthers.
news.head: Sam LaPorta hits paydirt in Sunday's loss
news.impact: LaPorta put up new season highs in receptions and yards Sunday night, tying for the team lead with eight grabs. LaPorta also scored for the second time this season. He's not a sure thing every week, but LaPorta is a definite top-10 TE with top-five upside the rest of the way.

news.body: Sam LaPorta caught 3-of-4 targets for 44 yards in a 31-24 win over the Jets.
news.head: Sam LaPorta tallies three receptions in Week 3
news.impact: LaPorta saw the bulk of the targets go to Amon-Ra St. Brown and Jahmyr Gibbs in the win over the Jets. Fantasy managers will hope that LaPorta can become more involved against the Panthers in Week 4.

news.body: Rams coach Sean McVay said Terrance Ferguson will not be designated to return from injured reserve this week.
news.head: Terrance Ferguson (ankle) will not return to practice this week
news.impact: Ferguson remains without a clear timetable to return. Tyler Higbee and Colby Parkinson will continue to lead a committee of tight ends.

news.body: Terrance Ferguson is not expected to be activated when first eligible next week.
news.head: Terrance Ferguson (ankle) not expected to be activated next week
news.impact: Ferguson will remain on injured reserve. He remains week-to-week.

news.body: The Rams placed TE Terrance Ferguson on injured reserve.
news.head: Terrance Ferguson (ankle) placed on IR
news.impact: Ferguson went down with the injury last Sunday. He will now miss at least the next four games.

news.body: Terrance Ferguson has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Eagles.
news.head: Terrance Ferguson (ankle) ruled out Sunday
news.impact: Ferguson will be sidelined as expected after leaving last Sunday's game early. Colby Parkinson will be questionable.

news.body: T.J. Hockenson caught 4-of-5 targets for 35 yards and a touchdown in the Vikings 16-10 win over the Colts.
news.head: T.J. Hockenson catches touchdown Sunday
news.impact: Hockenson hauled in a short touchdown from Kyler Murray. He'll be a low-end TE1 next week against the Lions.

news.body: T.J. Hockenson (concussion) practiced in a full capacity on Wednesday.
news.head: T.J. Hockenson (concussion) practices in full Wednesday
news.impact: Hockenson was previously going through the NFL's concussion protocols, but he was able to practice in full on Wednesday and should be fully cleared to play in time for Sunday's game. He isn't likely to be much more than a streaming option on a week-to-week basis for the foreseeable future, however.

news.body: T.J. Hockenson (concussion) will take part in Minnesota's practice on Wednesday.
news.head: T.J. Hockenson (concussion) will practice Wednesday
news.impact: The veteran tight end is going to be available to practice on Wednesday. He was placed in the NFL's concussion protocols before their bye week, but his time off allowed him to recover, and it looks like he will be available to play in Week 7. It remains to be seen if he will be limited at practice early in the week, however.

news.body: The Vikings placed TE T.J. Hockenson in concussion protocol.
news.head: T.J. Hockenson placed in concussion protocol
news.impact: Hockenson left Sunday's game early against the Saints. His status heading into Week 6 is up in the air.

news.body: Travis Kelce caught four of his eight targets for 44 yards in a 20-3 loss to the Seahawks in Week 7.
news.head: Travis Kelce catches four passes in Week 7
news.impact: Kelce led the Chiefs in targets and receiving yards while tying for the lead in catches in the disappointing loss. The veteran tight end has notched at least 44 receiving yards in five of his six games this year. He will be a low-end TE1 in Week 8 vs. the Broncos.

news.body: Travis Kelce was limited in practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Travis Kelce (ankle) limited in practice Wednesday
news.impact: Kelce is being managed in practice to start the week. He should be good to go in his usual role for Sunday.

news.body: Travis Kelce caught four passes for 53 yards in the Chiefs' 22-6 win over the Chargers in Week 6.
news.head: Travis Kelce Records 53 Receiving Yards in Week 6
news.impact: Kelce wasn't needed for a big performance with Kansas City controlling the game behind Walker and its defense. Still, 53 yards kept his floor intact despite failing to score. Kelce remains a weekly low-end TE1.

news.body: Travis Kelce caught two of his four targets for 15 yards in a 30-27 win over the Raiders in Week 4.
news.head: Travis Kelce quiet in Week 4 win
news.impact: Kelce was quiet in the win as Tyquan Thornton and Xavier Worthy did most of the damage in the passing attack. Kelce has been a solid fantasy tight end this season, catching 16 passes for 246 yards and two touchdowns in four games. He will be on bye in Week 5 before taking on the Chargers in Week 6.

news.body: Trey McBride caught 10 of 13 targets for 111 yards and one touchdown in the Cardinals' 30-16 loss to the Broncos in Week 7.
news.head: Trey McBride Goes Over 100 Yards, Scores in Week 7
news.impact: McBride accounted for 10 of Jacoby Brissett's 27 completions and 111 of his 272 passing yards. He also caught Arizona's only touchdown, scoring from seven yards out in the third quarter. With 13 targets and no other Cardinal seeing more than eight, McBride remains one of fantasy football's safest elite TE1 options.

news.body: Trey McBride hauled in 7-of-9 targets for 53 yards in Sunday's 18-16 win over the Los Angeles Rams.
news.head: Trey McBride leads team in receiving Sunday
news.impact: McBride continues to produce well in PPR scoring formats, hauling in seven passes in Sunday's upset win over the Rams. He wasn't able to turn those seven catches into much, but fantasy managers should still be satisfied with the performance that he put up.

news.body: Trey McBride hauled in 9-of-10 targets for 66 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 45-21 loss to the Detroit Lions.
news.head: Trey McBride hauls in touchdown Sunday
news.impact: The star tight end played well on Sunday. He was able to record 66 yards and a touchdown on his nine catches, which left him with a great fantasy total on the afternoon. He should continue to be great moving forward, even with Arizona not expected to win many games over the course of the season.

news.body: Trey McBride hauled in 7-of-12 targets for 31 yards in Sunday's 36-24 loss to the New York Giants.
news.head: Trey McBride hauls in seven passes Sunday
news.impact: McBride saw plenty of opportunities on Sunday, but he wasn't able to do much with them. His seven passes turned into just 31 yards, so if someone started him in a non-PPR league format, his fantasy finish was quite disappointing for them. He should bounce back and return to form sometime within the next week or two, however.

news.body: Tucker Kraft hauled in 4-of-6 targets for 49 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 20-17 loss to the Detroit Lions.
news.head: Tucker Kraft finds end zone Sunday
news.impact: Kraft had a solid game on Sunday. He was able to haul in four passes for 49 yards on the afternoon, one of which he was able to get into the end zone on as well. He should continue to be viewed as a weekly starter at the tight end position moving forward.

news.body: Tucker Kraft caught five of his eight targets for 37 yards in a 23-13 win over the Cowboys in Week 6.
news.head: Tucker Kraft catches five passes in Week 6
news.impact: Kraft finished tied for second on the team in targets but was able to manage just 37 yards in the win. The veteran tight end now has 25 catches for 249 yards and one touchdown in six games for the Packers this year. He will be a strong TE1 in Week 7 vs. the Lions.

news.body: Tucker Kraft caught all five of his targets for 64 yards while also rushing once for two yards in the Packers' 31-7 win over the Chicago Bears in Week 5.
news.head: Tucker Kraft sees six touches in Week 5
news.impact: Kraft has seen increased involvement in the Green Bay passing attack of late, logging five or more targets in each of his last three contests. The tight end will look to offer more impactful output moving forward, with a Week 6 contest against the Dallas Cowboys up next.

news.body: Tucker Kraft caught six of his seven targets for 42 yards and a touchdown while adding a three-yard run in a 17-14 win over the Buccaneers in Week 4.
news.head: Tucker Kraft finds the end zone in Week 4
news.impact: Kraft scored his first touchdown of the season on a two-yard pass from Jordan Love. The veteran tight end set a season-high in receptions in the game as he continues to ramp up after last season's ACL tear. Overall, Kraft has 15 catches for 148 yards and one touchdown. He will be a TE1 in fantasy in Week 5 against the Bears.

news.body: Tyler Higbee caught two of his three targets for 14 yards in the Rams' 35-21 win over the Las Vegas Raiders in Week 7.
news.head: Tyler Higbee quiet in Week 7 win
news.impact: Higbee has cooled off of late, finishing with less than 25 receiving yards in each of the last two contests. The tight end remains one of the more stable pass-catching options as part of a banged-up Rams offense, with a Week 8 contest against the Los Angeles Chargers up next.

news.body: Tyler Higbee caught four passes for 22 yards in Sunday's 18-16 loss to the Arizona Cardinals.
news.head: Tyler Higbee catches four passes Sunday
news.impact: Higbee caught four passes over the course of the afternoon on Sunday, but he wasn't able to do much with them, racking up just 22 yards in a loss to the Cardinals. Fantasy managers shouldn't have high expectations for him moving forward.

news.body: Tyler Higbee is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Cardinals.
news.head: Tyler Higbee off injury report Sunday
news.impact: Higbee will be good to go despite not practicing on Friday.

news.body: Tyler Higbee caught five of his six targets for 83 yards in a 37-34 overtime loss to the Bills in Week 5.
news.head: Tyler Higbee goes for 83 yards in Week 5
news.impact: Higbee finished second on the Rams in receiving on Monday night, behind only Puka Nacua. The veteran tight end has earned a larger role in the team's offense thanks to some injuries in the LA tight-end room, having caught 18 passes for 212 yards and a touchdown over his past three contests. Higbee is looking like a solid fantasy option heading into Week 6 vs. Arizona.

news.body: Tyler Warren (groin) was officially limited at practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Tyler Warren (groin) officially limited Wednesday
news.impact: Warren was able to participate in Wednesday's practice. He has missed multiple games while dealing with this groin issue, but it looks like he's trending towards making his return in Week 8. He will be a must-start fantasy option if active, even with Indianapolis getting rid of several key players for future picks.

news.body: Tyler Warren (groin) has been ruled out for Week 7 by the Indianapolis Colts according to Adam Schefter.
news.head: Tyler Warren (groin) ruled out for Week 7

news.body: Tyler Warren did not practice on Thursday.
news.head: Tyler Warren (groin) not practicing Thursday
news.impact: Warren missed another practice. He'll likely need to practice in some capacity on Friday to have a chance to return this week.

news.body: Tyler Warren (groin) did not take part in Indianapolis' practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Tyler Warren (groin) doesn't practice Wednesday
news.impact: Warren was sidelined in Week 6 due to a groin issue, and he wasn't able to practice on Wednesday for the same reason. He's at risk of being sidelined again this week, but we won't know his official status until sometime later on in the week.

news.body: A.J. Brown (knee/ankle) is dealing with a knee issue and is officially not practicing for the Patriots on Thursday.
news.head: A.J. Brown (knee/ankle) officially not practicing Thursday
news.impact: Brown has been nursing his ankle issue for a while already, but now he's also dealing with a new knee issue and is not practicing on Thursday because of it. It seems to pose a real threat for his availability for Week 8, and fantasy managers should continue to closely monitor all updates about his health throughout the rest of the week.

news.body: A.J. Brown was not seen at practice on Thursday.
news.head: A.J. Brown (ankle/knee) not at practice Thursday
news.impact: Brown was limited in practice to open the week on Wednesday. He'll need to be monitored in practice on Friday.

news.body: A.J. Brown was limited in practice on Wednesday.
news.head: A.J. Brown (ankle) limited in practice Wednesday
news.impact: Brown should be good to go for Sunday's game against the Dolphins. He is a volatile WR2 for fantasy managers given his involvement and drop struggles.

news.body: A.J. Brown hauled in 3-of-6 targets for 48 yards in Thursday's 30-24 loss to the Bears.
news.head: A.J. Brown grabs three passes in Thursday's loss
news.impact: Since returning from a four-week absence, Brown has now secured just 6-of-16 targets for 75 yards over the last two games. He looked a little more up to speed Thursday night, but he's still well below the top-tier fantasy option he once was. Better games should be on the way from Brown, but right now, he's difficult to trust in fantasy lineups.

news.body: Amon-Ra St. Brown practiced on Thursday.
news.head: Amon-Ra St. Brown (ankle) practices Thursday
news.impact: Brown was not seen during the open portion of practice on Wednesday. His return on Thursday is a good sign for his status for Sunday's game against the Vikings.

news.body: Amon-Ra St. Brown hauled in 9-of-11 targets for 153 yards in Sunday's 20-17 win over the Green Bay Packers.
news.head: Amon-Ra St. Brown leads team in receiving Sunday
news.impact: The veteran wideout played very well on Sunday. He led the team with 153 receiving yards over the course of the afternoon, although he wasn't able to get into the end zone to put the cherry on top. Fantasy managers should continue to regard him as a top-tier option moving forward.

news.body: Amon-Ra St. Brown caught 6-of-11 targets for 69 yards in Sunday's 45-21 win over the Arizona Cardinals.
news.head: Amon-Ra St. Brown racks up 69 yards Sunday
news.impact: The star wideout had an okay game on Sunday. He racked up 69 yards in an easy win over the Cardinals, but he wasn't able to get into the end zone at all, which left him with a mediocre fantasy total to his standards. He has had a great start to the season overall and should continue to be a high-end fantasy option moving forward.

news.body: Amon Ra St. Brown came up with 8-of-11 targets for 75 yards in Sunday's 32-26 loss to the Panthers.
news.head: Amon-Ra St. Brown makes eight grabs in Week 4 loss
news.impact: St. Brown failed to make it four straight games with a touchdown to start the season, but he still produced a solid showing. St. Brown has largely delivered for fantasy managers over the first quarter of the season, averaging nearly eight receptions for more than 75 yards with five scores to this point. He remains a certain WR1.

news.body: Antonio Williams caught three of his four targets for 50 yards in a 23-17 loss to the 49ers in Week 6.
news.head: Antonio Williams finishes with 50 receiving yards in Week 6
news.impact: Williams finished third on the team in receiving in the loss on Monday night. The rookie wideout has shown flashes this season but his role hasn't been large enough to be trusted as a weekly starter in fantasy. He could see more work after his bye in Week 7, after Terry McLaurin had to be carted off the field during Monday night's game against the 49ers. Williams is worth a waiver claim in most leagues this week.

news.body: Antonio Williams caught all three of his targets for 31 yards in the Commanders' 27-27 tie with the New York Giants in Week 5.
news.head: Antonio Williams quiet in Week 5 tie
news.impact: Williams has struggled to make an impact of late, finishing with less than 35 receiving yards in each of the last four games. The wideout remains another risky pass-catching option in the Washington offense for head coach Dan Quinn, with a Week 6 contest against the San Francisco 49ers up next.

news.body: Antonio Williams caught 3-of-8 targets for 21 yards in the Commanders loss to the Colts.
news.head: Antonio Williams hauls in three passes in Week 4
news.impact: Williams was second on the team in targets, just one behind Stefon Diggs. Williams could continue to see more playing time next week if Terry McLaurin does not return from his hamstring injury.

news.body: Antonio Williams caught two of his four targets for 15 yards in the Commanders’ 33-31 Week 3 win over the Seattle Seahawks.
news.head: Antonio Williams quiet in Week 3 win
news.impact: Williams has fallen back to earth after an impressive showing in Week 1, finishing with less than 25 receiving yards in each of the last two games. The wideout remains a risky-pass catching option in an inconsistent offense early on, with a Week 4 matchup against the Indianapolis Colts up next.

news.body: Caleb Douglas caught 2-of-3 targets for 70 yards and two touchdowns in a 28-25 win over the Jets.
news.head: Caleb Douglas finds the end zone twice in Week 7
news.impact: Douglas found the end zone on a seven yard reception and a 63-yard reception to help pace the Dolphins to their first win of the season. This marked the first game Douglas has played in since suffering an injury in Week 2, and he provided an immediate jolt in the Dolphins' passing attack. Douglas will look to build on this performance against the Patriots in Week 8.

news.body: Dolphins WR Caleb Douglas (ankle) is officially active for Week 7 matchup with the Jets.
news.head: Caleb Douglas (ankle) officially active for Week 7
news.impact: Douglas has been out of action since Week 2. Prior to his injury, he had seven receptions for 113 yards in his first two NFL games. Fantasy managers should expect him to be involved in the Dolphins' passing attack.

news.body: Caleb Douglas (ankle) is expected to play against the Jets on Sunday.
news.head: Caleb Douglas (ankle) expected to play in Week 7
news.impact: After a strong NFL debut back in Week 1, Douglas was knocked out early in his second career game and has not played for the Dolphins since. That should change this week, as the rookie has been active at practice leading into a divisional matchup against the Jets. Fellow rookie Kevin Coleman Jr. likely stands to lose snaps if Douglas does return.

news.body: Caleb Douglas (ankle) was limited at practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Caleb Douglas (ankle) limited at practice Wednesday
news.impact: The rookie seems to be doing much better after Miami's bye week. He was able to practice in a limited fashion on Wednesday after missing several games with an ankle issue. His return would be good news for Miami's entire offense moving forward, though he isn't likely to have much individual fantasy value for the time being.

news.body: Carnell Tate did not practice on Thursday.
news.head: Carnell Tate (shoulder) misses practice again Thursday
news.impact: Tate missed a second straight practice to begin the week. He'll likely have to practice in some capacity on Friday to have a chance to play this weekend.

news.body: Carnell Tate missed practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Carnell Tate (shoulder) not practicing Wednesday
news.impact: Tate is dealing with a shoulder injury. He'll need to be monitored in practice the rest of the week.

news.body: Carnell Tate caught five of his seven targets for 69 yards and lost a fumble in a 27-24 loss to the Browns in Week 7.
news.head: Carnell Tate goes for 69 yards in Week 7
news.impact: After slow performances in Weeks 1 and 2, Tate continues to ascend in the Tennessee offense as he's hit at least 58 receiving yards and five catches in four of his past five contests. The rookie wideout will be a solid fantasy play in Week 8 vs. the Bengals.

news.body: Carnell Tate caught six of seven targets for 70 yards and a touchdown in the Titans' 26-20 win over the Colts on Sunday.
news.head: Carnell Tate snags touchdown in win over Colts
news.impact: Titans QB Cam Ward threw for 11 completions and 107 yards in this contest, meaning Tate accounted for over 50% of his completions and 65% of his passing yards. Only four Titans caught a pass on Sunday, and only Tate and Wan'Dale Robinson went over 10 yards. Tate has been a volume magnet so far this year, and it looks like he will continue to be. He's closing in on WR2 territory, but Ward's inconsistency will keep his floor low.

news.body: CeeDee Lamb hauled in 5-of-12 targets for 74 yards and two touchdowns in Monday night's 38-21 win over the Philadelphia Eagles.
news.head: CeeDee Lamb hauls in two touchdowns Monday
news.impact: Lamb wasn't able to connect with Prescott on over half of his targets, but he was able to make the most out of the ones that he did catch, finishing with 74 yards and two touchdowns in a comfortable win over the Eagles. He will continue to be a top-tier fantasy option moving forward, assuming he remains healthy.

news.body: CeeDee Lamb caught nine of his 18 targets for 70 yards in a 23-13 loss to the Packers in Week 6.
news.head: CeeDee Lamb goes for 70 yards in Week 6
